serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin, each bucket's own table for bookedMin, service_capacities reserved_minutes carried as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin is modelled service minutes available; bookedMin is the authoritative load from each bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin is service_capacities' own reserved figure, kept only so its drift stays visible and never used as the booked side; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity

infleets.note: IAH (200/mo) has no dashboard site and is excluded by design. ATL 450 vs 750 unresolved (row 16 of the tracker carries the higher scenario). Morrow/Marietta 15/15 split is an assumption, not a stated rule.

orderCapacity.note: Static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies to every day of the window; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity (not an all-order ceiling); null means not configured, never a ceiling of zero
